title: Reintroductions can backfire by destabilising food webs and triggering further extinction cascades: analysis code and simulation data
description: Analysis code, analysis-ready simulation data, additional simulation outputs, and a pinned snapshot of the Julia simulation source for the predator reintroduction study. The R input contains 69,895 records; the published analysis script filters these to 10,969 baseline simulations. See DATA_README.md for contents, filtering, and reproducibility limitations.
